title: Admin SSE can read and reprocess another user's private interview
suggested-fix: Require public scope or an explicitly authorized audited support grant before loading or processing an interview; add a cross-user marker denial test.

title: Admin trash returns private interview and question bodies
suggested-fix: Scope trash queries to public rows and explicitly authorized support cases; add U1-private/U2-private marker tests for each file type.

title: Admin personal-bank rebuild implicitly promotes private questions
suggested-fix: Remove implicit public merge from personal rebuild; require a PublicPromotionRequest and explicit approval; reverse the test that currently expects promotion.

title: Legacy retry lets an admin replay another user's upload as its owner
suggested-fix: Apply the root retry owner check to the legacy endpoint or add a separately authorized and audited support operation; never attribute the work to the original owner.

title: Admin analysis-status scans private interview metadata
suggested-fix: Restrict the query to public interviews or an explicit audited support scope and test that unrelated private IDs and metadata are absent.

title: AC-029 trace omits an existing-public-canonical match and live queue path
suggested-fix: Seed a public canonical hit and assert the private resolution points to it without changing public content, sources, or frequency; add the Redis/ARQ/browser public-share and review recovery leg.
